name: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge NXT
description: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge NXT is a nonprofit fundraising CRM for constituents, campaigns, funds, appeals, gifts, opportunities, memberships, events, volunteers and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Raiser's Edge NXT is visible as a SKY application and subscription review preview. Relay will not request consent or expose agent actions until its production application, subscription keys and multi-customer distribution path are approved.

capabilities.label: Access authorized fundraising CRM data
capabilities.description: After Blackbaud approves Relay's SKY application and subscription, expose only reviewed capabilities within the connected environment and consenting user's permissions.

blocked.label: Connect before SKY application registration
blocked.description: Relay has not registered its production SKY application, redirect URI, scopes and credential-rotation controls.

blocked.label: Call SKY API without an approved subscription
blocked.description: Every request requires Blackbaud's approved subscription key in addition to the consenting user's OAuth bearer token.

blocked.label: Expose people and financial data before review
blocked.description: Constituents, contacts, consent, gifts, opportunities, memberships, event participants and financial fields remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Run agent actions before provider setup
blocked.description: No fundraising, CRM, reporting, webhook, mutation or raw SKY API action is callable before application, subscription, environment and distribution review.

approvalProfiles.label: SKY provider setup required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable until Relay has an approved SKY application, subscription and production distribution contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Blackbaud approves Relay's SKY production setup.
No Hermes tools are callable until Blackbaud approves Relay's SKY production setup.

providerSetup.blocker: A production integration requires a registered SKY application, approved subscription keys, customer environment connection, user OAuth consent and a reviewed multi-customer distribution path; Relay has not completed that provider setup.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register Relay's SKY application and exact production redirect, request the required subscriptions, define least-privilege scopes, complete the Blackbaud Partner/ISV review for broad distribution, and validate environment connection, consent, refresh, rotation, revocation and field boundaries.

evidence.supports: Blackbaud requires both a developer subscription key and a consenting customer's OAuth bearer token on SKY API requests and recommends its ISV partner program for multi-customer applications.
Blackbaud documents mandatory SKY application registration, client credentials, customer-environment connection, Marketplace permissions and partner Marketplace listing guidance.
SKY API uses Authorization Code OAuth, one-hour access tokens, renewable connectivity, user consent and scopes tied to the user's account and organization.
Raiser's Edge NXT exposes broad fundraising, constituent, gift, event, membership, volunteer, reporting and webhook APIs that require field-level review before mounting agent tools.
